ms.report:
The full p2p functionality is now operational.
You can see in the bellow video that we have 3 Guardian angels running the bridge with GA1 acting as the leader, after we kill the leader an a short cooldown elapses the remaining 2 nodes start and election and select GA2 to be the leader, you can see during this period that GA2 is set to "candidate" before being accepted as "leader", after the leader is selected we restart GA1 that joins the quorum is a "learner" state and quicly accepts GA2 as the leader and takes the role of "follower" 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yKOE0V01oIU
The transaction history is also now available as per the milestone criteria a guide has been published.
